text:
oliver: I pushed the changes addressing the feedback from yesterday's review. I updated the endpoint timeout and added a small unit test.

amanda: checking now, thanks. did you also update the changelog?

oliver: yes — added a single line under 'runtime fixes' + linked the PR in the changelog. PTAL @amanda

amanda: small nit: please rename `max_conn` -> `max_connections` in the test, otherwise LGTM

oliver: done, pushed. re-ran tests locally (all green)

raj: quick question — do we need a migration note for the config change? won't block me from approving if it's small

oliver: good catch. added a one-liner note in docs/upgrade.md. it's backward compatible; no runtime migration required

taylor: i'm around for the 17:00 UTC cut. can approve once amanda + raj are ok

amanda: approve :thumbsup:

raj: lgtm, one minor comment but harmless, approve

oliver: thanks folks. tagging release bot

release-bot: release scheduled: v0.31.3 will be cut at 17:00 UTC. if any rollback needed, comment here within the next 30m

oliver: assigning merge owner to @taylor for the actual cut — taylor, can you take custody at release time?

taylor: yep, i'll handle the merge + tag. remind me ~5m before

amanda: congrats on the quick turnaround :tada:

oliver: thanks. leaving the PR link here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/912

taylor: got it, will do the final smoke then cut

oliver: if anything unexpected pops up, we can revert and reopen the previous release branch. thanks everyone
